{{Quote|Narcassan&mdash;are you any relation to a woman named Shalla?''"<br />"''My aunt. Her sister, Vula, is my mother. But my father was kind of a waste of breathable air, so I took my grandfather’s family name.|Voort saBinring to Wran Narcassan|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''Nelprin family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family headed by former [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Vyn Narcassan]]. Shortly before [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] seized power and declared the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Narcassan engineered his disappearance, and even [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] failed to apprehend him. He had two daughters, [[Vula Nelprin|Vula]] and [[Shalla Nelprin]], whom he trained in hand-to-hand techniques, leading both to become known for their proficiency in unarmed combat. They both joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and subsequently the [[New Republic]].<ref name="MK" /> 

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Vula's son, [[Wran Narcassan]], joined the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], like his aunt Shalla before him. He had issues with his [[Wran Narcassan's father|father]] and decided to take on his grandfather's family name instead.<ref name="MK" />
